finalText:
Build passes clean now: 0 errors, exit code 0.

The real bug was in `src/core/settings.js` — `resolveConfig` referenced a variable named `retries` that never existed (should have been `env.retries`), so every build crashed with a `ReferenceError` at the link stage. Fixed it to `env.retries || 3`.

The other three warnings (deprecated `crypto.createCipher`, an unused export, a circular import) are just noise the build already tolerates — it says "0 errors" with them still present, so I left those alone unless you want them cleaned up too.
